# FluxWall

> FluxWall is a free live wallpaper app for Android. Choose a background, make it yours, and download it from Google Play.

## Canonical website

- Website: https://fluxwall.anvik.studio/
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rrapps.infinitetunnel
- Public source repository: https://github.com/abhishekBansal/fluxwall

## What FluxWall is

FluxWall is a free live wallpaper app for Android. Users can explore a curated collection of moving backgrounds, preview them, and personalize settings such as color, speed, glow, and movement. The Android app is available on Google Play.

FluxWall is designed for Android devices that support live wallpapers. It does not require an account, and the app contains no ads or tracking.

## Featured worlds

The public website showcases five curated experiences:

- Infinite Tunnel: a fast-moving tunnel journey with luminous rings.
- Magic Fluids: rich, colorful motion with flowing color.
- Aurora Field: soft northern lights over a dark sky.
- Synthwave Sun: a bright retro sunset with a neon horizon.
- Galaxy: deep space with slow-moving stars.

## Full wallpaper collection

The Android app includes 29 live wallpapers. The website shows a thumbnail for each one:

Infinite Tunnel, Magic Fluids, Event Horizon, Ripple, Nebula Voyage, Fractals, Aurora Field, Ink in Water, Plasma, Grand Spiral, Synthwave Sun, Downpour, Rain on Glass, Lava Lamp, Fireplace, Jellyfish Drift, Celestial Tide, Liquid Metals, Crystal Cluster, Silver Blade, Matrix Rain, Wireframe Mountains, Endless Stars, Fireflies, Pulse Lines, Hexagonal Grids, Perlin Noise, Blooming Flowers and Galaxy.

Some wallpapers respond to touch or tilt. For example, Ripple turns the screen into water you can tap, and Event Horizon reacts when you hold your finger on it.

## How it works

FluxWall creates the movement on your phone, so scenes can feel different every time you look at them. The public website includes a preview of the featured experiences.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is FluxWall a video wallpaper?

No. FluxWall creates a moving scene on your phone. It is not a fixed video loop.

### What can users customize?

Each wallpaper can include its own controls. Available settings may include color, speed, glow, and movement.

### Does FluxWall need an account?

No. FluxWall does not require an account. Favorites and presets are stored locally on the device according to the app's user settings.

### Does FluxWall contain ads?

No ads, no account, and no tracking inside the app.

### Where can FluxWall be downloaded?

FluxWall is available on Google Play at:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rrapps.infinitetunnel

## Content and crawler policy

The public website is intended to be readable by people, search engines, and user-directed AI agents. The canonical website is the source of truth for product facts and links. Crawlers should respect the site's `robots.txt`, canonical URLs, and `sitemap.xml`.

The website's public catalog is intentionally curated. The private application repository contains the complete implementation and additional internal development material.
